body_text: Just a quick note for this newsletter. I hope everyone has had a good summer and is ready for fall. This time of year always leaves people wondering how the rest of the year is going to go. That is especially true now with mortgage rates up in the air and the real estate market still facing difficult challenges and some uncertainty. During times like this, it is important to keep working hard (maybe even harder) and do what you know works best for you, because there’s always some business out there. Whether because of divorce, a death, or financial reasons, some properties must be sold and they eventually find a buyer. But the key is to keep working. Every person I know who is successful is a hard worker. I am convinced that it’s not intelligence, talent or even education that count the most. Those things help, but perseverance, patience, and hard work will always win out over those that use education or ability as a crutch. We all know very smart and talented people who are NOT successful. Many say that they want to leverage their time, work smarter not harder, or “Hey, I want to have a life too, you know”, and many other things. I hate to break it to you, but someone has to take the pressure, make sure things get done, and put in the work, and that someone is you. Have a great fall and don’t eat too much Halloween candy (or go ahead if you want, I mean it’s a free country). I wish all of you much success and thanks so much for subscribing.

title: Workiva Appoints Barbara Larson as EVP & Chief Financial Officer to Drive Operational Excellence
summary: NEW YORK - December 10, 2025 – Workiva Inc. (NYSE:WK), a leading, AI-powered platform for transparency, accountability, and trust, today announced the appointment of Barbara Larson as EVP and Chief Financial Officer, effective January 20, 2026.
body_text: Former Workday CFO Joins Workiva During Pivotal Phase of Growth NEW YORK-December 10, 2025 – Workiva Inc. (NYSE:WK), a leading, AI-powered platform for transparency, accountability, and trust, today announced the appointment of Barbara Larson as EVP & Chief Financial Officer, effective January 20, 2026. Larson brings a proven track record and deep operational experience scaling high-growth public software companies. She has spent more than 20 years in financial leadership positions, most recently serving as CFO at SentinelOne. Prior to SentinelOne, Larson spent a decade in financial leadership roles at Workday, including CFO, where she led overall finance and accounting functions, internal audit, and investor relations, and also advised on business strategy and product development. “Barbara is a seasoned financial leader with a proven track record, and we are thrilled to welcome her to the Workiva team. Her experience is especially relevant as we continue to focus on profitable growth,” said Julie Iskow, CEO, Workiva. “Barbara’s expertise will be a key asset in helping Workiva’s customers leverage AI for financial transformation, while building trust and transparency with stakeholders.” As Workiva CFO, Larson will oversee Workiva’s financial strategy and operations as the company focuses on accelerating its global growth and expanding the adoption of its secure, audit-ready, AI-powered platform. Partnering closely with the executive leadership team, including newly named Chief Revenue Officer Michael Pinto, Larson will also play a key role in driving operational rigor across the organization to unlock new efficiencies. “I am incredibly excited to join Workiva at this significant moment in its growth trajectory. The CFO community recognizes that the need for connected data to power transparency and trust has never been greater, and as a Workiva user, I believe their platform is uniquely positioned to address this massive global market opportunity,” said Larson, incoming CFO, Workiva. “I look forward to partnering with Julie and the leadership team to drive sustainable growth while delivering increasing value to our customers and shareholders.” Prior to Workday and SentinelOne, Larson held senior financial roles at VMware, TIBCO Software, and Symantec. She also serves as a board member at Equifax and holds a Bachelor of Business Administration degree from the University of Arizona. Update on Workiva CFO Transition Workiva previously announced that Jill Klindt, Executive Vice President, Chief Financial Officer and Treasurer, will step down in 2025 following a transition period, and that her employment will end on December 26, 2025. On December 3, 2025, the Board appointed Julie Iskow as Interim Chief Financial Officer and Treasurer (“Interim CFO”), effective as of December 27, 2025. Ms. Iskow will serve as Interim CFO until January 20, 2026, and will remain the Company’s President, CEO and director through and after the interim period. title: How NuFilebox Reverse strengthens file security at Nubank
summary: The joint research effort between UFBA, IFBA, and Nubank that brings Clojure to the center of cybersecurity
body_text: During the second edition of Clojure South, Eric Bispo and Isaac Borges took the stage to present one of the most fascinating projects developed within NuFuturo, the research partnership between Nubank and institutions such as UFBA, IFBA, and UFCG. Their work, the NuFilebox Reverse, emerged from a very concrete challenge faced by Nubank’s legal team: receiving, analyzing, and processing external files securely in a workflow that involves multiple languages, large data volumes, and a fully cloud-based infrastructure. The session showed how academic research and functional engineering can complement each other to create a robust upload pipeline, placing Clojure at the center of a security architecture built on the zero-knowledge principle. The context of the problem Companies that interact with other companies depend on the constant exchange of documents. At Nubank, many of these files are large, sensitive, and originate from different external sources. Every received file represents a potential risk. High volume creates performance and scalability challenges. The need for security goes beyond simple post-upload analysis, a zero-knowledge architecture imposes a strict constraint: the server cannot, at any point, have access to the decrypted content of these files. The key question guiding the research was simple in theory but complex in practice: how can third parties send files to Nubank without exposing the system to threats and without creating exceptions that compromise privacy or data integrity. Check our job opportunities Why Clojure became the foundation Choosing Clojure was not merely pragmatic, even though Nubank is the largest company in the world using the language at scale. Clojure proved ideal for handling sensitive metadata, temporary tokens, and cryptographic keys thanks to its immutability. Clojure’s ability to handle concurrency made it easier to process extremely large files split into smaller chunks. The functional paradigm made the composition of security steps clearer and more reliable. And interoperability with the Java ecosystem opened the door to stable, battle-tested libraries widely used in the cybersecurity industry. Over time, even with other technologies surrounding the system, Clojure naturally emerged as the core of the NuFilebox Reverse. A security approach that starts on the client side In the traditional upload model, the client sends the file via HTTPS, the server receives the content in plain text, and only then applies encryption before storing it. This pattern, although common, presents an obvious vulnerability: if the server is compromised, the files are exposed before they are protected. The team took the opposite approach. Encryption occurs before the file even leaves the client machine. The front end requests only minimal data from the back end, such as the key and the Initialization Vector (IV), which determine where the encryption starts. The server records this information and stores it in DynamoDB without ever touching the file’s content. From there, the front-end itself splits the file into smaller parts, encrypts each piece locally, and uploads them directly to S3 through pre-signed URLs. The server never sees the content. It manages only metadata. Logic stays on one side, data on the other. It is a truly zero-knowledge architecture, built on the principle of security by design. The entire pipeline was created so that the file is protected from the very first moment of its journey. Decryption, reassembly, and the role of Clojure Once the encrypted file chunks arrive at S3, AWS triggers a chain of events. Lambdas determine which workflow to follow and route the file to the service responsible for merging and decrypting the fragments. This step, implemented in Clojure, consults information stored in DynamoDB such as the key, IV, identifier, and file name, and begins the reconstruction process. Each part is downloaded from S3, decrypted individually, and reassembled in its original order. This step is essential for identifying malicious patterns, since a malware signature may be split between two file parts. Full reconstruction ensures accuracy in the next phase. A second layer of defense with YARA Rules Once the file is restored to its original format, NuFilebox Reverse performs malware analysis using YARA, one of the most established tools in the industry for threat detection. YARA allows the creation of rules that describe suspicious behaviors, code fragments, encrypted patterns, improper API calls, questionable external connections, or even entire code sections characteristic of specific malware families. The team combined manually created rules, rules from trusted repositories, and the generation of an indexed file to streamline scanning. How the system handled increasingly large files The group also shared practical results. Files up to five hundred megabytes completed the process in just a few seconds. One-gigabyte files took about four minutes. Ten-gigabyte files finished in around forty-five minutes. In the most extreme scenario, thirty-gigabyte files concluded in roughly two hours. Even in these cases, performance was better than what is typically seen in widely used services adopted by large companies. And unlike many of these platforms, NuFilebox Reverse integrates malware detection before any data enters Nubank’s internal ecosystem. Applied research with real-world impact One of the most compelling aspects of the presentation was seeing how NuFuturo operates in practice. The project brings together students, professors, researchers, and engineers in continuous cycles of collaboration. Eric and Isaac’s team received direct guidance from Nubank professionals starting in April 2024. The result is a system that solves a real problem, creates opportunities for new talent, and expands the use of Clojure into areas that go beyond typical product workflows. The final session brought questions about immutability, possible uses of Datomic, implementation decisions, and future challenges. The presenters emphasized that there is still plenty of room to evolve, from exploring more performant ways to execute YARA rules to experimenting with new approaches that could reduce processing time for extremely large files. NuFilebox Reverse is a concrete example of how partnerships between industry and academia can produce solutions that combine deep research, functional engineering, and direct impact on a real-world problem. It demonstrates how long-term vision, technical curiosity, and institutional collaboration can transform into technology that protects millions of people every single day.

title: Sutro Biopharma Announces First Cohort of Patients Dosed in Phase 1 Trial of STRO-004, a Next-Generation Tissue Factor ADC, in TF-Expressing Solid Tumors
summary: – Initial clinical data expected mid-2026 – SOUTH SAN FRANCISCO, Calif., Dec. 03, 2025 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Sutro Biopharma, Inc. (Sutro or…...
body_text: Sutro Biopharma Announces First Cohort of Patients Dosed in Phase 1 Trial of STRO-004, a Next-Generation Tissue Factor ADC, in TF-Expressing Solid Tumors December 03, 2025 8:00am EST Download as PDF – Initial clinical data expected mid-2026 – SOUTH SAN FRANCISCO, Calif., Dec. 03, 2025 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Sutro Biopharma, Inc. (Sutro or the Company) (NASDAQ: STRO), a clinical stage oncology company pioneering site-specific and novel-format antibody drug conjugates (ADCs), today announced that the patients in the first cohort have been dosed in its Phase 1 trial evaluating STRO-004 in a range of Tissue Factor (TF) expressing solid tumors. STRO-004 is the Company’s TF-targeting exatecan ADC engineered for best-in-class stability, potency, and tumor selectivity using Sutro’s proprietary cell-free platform. “Dosing the initial patients in this trial marks an important milestone in bringing forward new treatment options for patients with TF–expressing cancers—many of whom face limited therapy options and difficult prognoses . We’ve seen strong engagement from our clinical investigators, who recognize the potential of STRO-004 to address a pressing need in oncology—and we’re proud of the speed and precision with which our team brought the program into the clinic,” said Jane Chung, Chief Executive Officer of Sutro Biopharma. “STRO-004 is engineered to deliver potent, sustained anti-tumor activity and higher exposure compared to approved therapies, with the goal of reaching tumors that are resistant to standard approaches. Through this trial, we aim to generate early insights into safety and activity that will guide development in areas of urgent unmet need. We are deeply grateful to the patients and investigators participating in this study and look forward to sharing initial data in mid-2026.” The Phase 1 open-label, multicenter trial is designed to evaluate the safety, pharmacokinetics, and preliminary anti-tumor activity of STRO-004 in patients with advanced TF-expressing solid tumors, including non-small cell lung cancer, head and neck squamous cell carcinoma, cervical cancer, colorectal cancer, pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma, and bladder cancer. The dose-escalation phase includes multiple cohorts with ascending dose levels, supported by strong tolerability in non-human primates at up to 50 mg/kg. Sutro’s design enables high entry doses, with the goal of rapidly identifying a recommended Phase 2 dose and early signs of clinical activity. More information can be found at: https://clinicaltrials.gov/study/NCT07227168 . About STRO-004 STRO-004 is a next-generation antibody-drug conjugate (ADC) targeting tissue factor (TF), a clinically validated tumor-associated antigen expressed across multiple solid tumors. In preclinical studies, STRO-004 demonstrated robust anti-tumor activity, favorable tolerability, and higher exposure compared to approved therapies. Developed using Sutro Biopharma’s proprietary cell-free platform, STRO-004 features an Fc-silent, high affinity antibody, with site-specific β-glucuronidase cleavable linker and exatecan payload at a drug-to-antibody ratio of 8 (DAR8). This design aims to enhance stability, reduce off-target toxicity, and maximize efficacy. It is currently being evaluated in a Phase 1 trial in patients with a range of TF-expressing solid tumors. About Sutro Biopharma Sutro Biopharma, Inc. is advancing a next-generation antibody-drug conjugate (ADC) platform designed to deliver single- and dual-payload ADCs that enable meaningful breakthroughs for patients with cancer. By fully optimizing the antibody, linker, and payload, Sutro’s cell-free platform produces ADCs that are engineered to improve drug exposure, reduce side effects, and expand the range of treatable tumor types. With unique capabilities in dual-payload ADCs, Sutro aims to overcome treatment resistance and redefine what’s possible in cancer therapy. The Company’s pipeline of single- and dual-payload ADCs targets large oncology markets with limited treatment options and significant need for improved therapies. For more information, follow Sutro on social media @Sutrobio or visit www.sutrobio.com . title: Multiplayer Gaming Communication Guide: Team Coordination Tips
summary: Master multiplayer voice chat with proven team communication strategies. Learn callouts, mic setup, and coordination tactics that improve win rates.
body_text: Competitive multiplayer gaming isn't just about mechanical skill or map knowledge. 93% of players actively engage in gaming while using voice communication platforms , and research shows that communication patterns directly predict team performance in online games . Whether you're coordinating rushes in tactical shooters or calling out rotations in battle royales, clear team communication separates winning squads from losing ones. Poor communication costs rounds. A teammate who can't hear your callout because of mic static, or who misunderstands "left" when you mean "stage left," creates openings for the enemy team. Effective gaming communication is learnable. With the right setup, habits, and strategies, you can transform your squad's coordination. Why Voice Chat Quality Matters for Team Performance Your headset serves as your squad's communication lifeline. Crystal-clear voice transmission is essential for tactical effectiveness. Poor microphone quality actively undermines your team's ability to execute plays. The Stealth 700 Gen 3 Headset delivers professional-grade mic clarity with flip-to-mute functionality, preventing accidental background noise transmission during critical plays. Position your boom microphone about one finger-width away from the corner of your mouth, angled slightly away from your breathing path. Master the Fundamentals of Gaming Communication Use Clear, Specific Callouts Vague communication loses rounds. Instead of saying "enemy spotted," provide actionable intel. "Two enemies, mid-bridge, one sniper" gives your team everything they need to respond effectively. Learn map-specific callouts for competitive games. "A site," "heaven," "connector," and "spawn" mean something specific. Use established callouts instead of vague instructions like "over there" or "to your left." Practice Voice Chat Etiquette Speak clearly and mute yourself when not providing game-relevant information. Your teammates need to hear footsteps and ability sounds, not background noise. The Atlas Air Headset features a noise-cancelling microphone that filters background noise, keeping comms clean even in louder environments. Avoid talking over your in-game leader. If your team has designated someone to make macro calls, respect their authority and add tactical information between their calls. Build Positive Team Dynamics Positive communication builds team morale and prevents tilting. When a teammate makes a mistake, move on. When they clutch a round, acknowledge it. Research shows that voice communication causes more positive emotional effects compared to text chat , making encouraging teammates even more effective through voice channels. Advanced Team Coordination Strategies Assign Roles and Responsibilities Many multiplayer games feature specialized roles like tanks, healers, and entry fraggers. Clear role assignment prevents overlap and ensures every team need is covered. Designate an in-game leader to make macro calls while everyone else focuses on executing strategy. Adapt Your Communication to Game Pace Adjust communication density based on game state. During mid-round action, keep comms tight and information-focused. Between rounds, discuss broader strategy. Some situations demand complete silence—when one teammate is clutching a 1v3, let them focus without unnecessary cheerleading. Use Alternative Communication Systems Not everyone wants to use voice chat. Games like Apex Legends feature robust ping systems that let players communicate without a mic. Gaming sessions become three times longer when playing with friends using voice communication . A dedicated communication server lets your team coordinate schedules and maintain team culture between sessions. Set Up Your Audio for Optimal Team Communication Optimize Your Headset Settings EQ settings can elevate voice chat quality. Mid frequencies between 250Hz and 4kHz bring out voice clarity for team communication. Adjusting your equalizer to emphasize mid-range frequencies increases vocal clarity while minimizing interference from game background noise. The Stealth 600 Headset offers excellent noise isolation and clear voice transmission at a budget-friendly price point. Test microphone settings before jumping into ranked matches. Choose the Right Wireless Technology Look for headsets with 2.4GHz wireless connectivity for optimal mic clarity and minimal latency. Bluetooth introduces audio delay that matters when reacting to footsteps or ability sounds. The Stealth 500 Headset combines wireless convenience with high-quality audio and a clear microphone. For competitive gaming where precise audio positioning matters most, the Stealth Pro Headset delivers tournament-level audio with premium noise isolation. Building Your Complete Gaming Setup Effective communication extends beyond headsets. The Victrix Pro BFG Reloaded Wireless Controller offers precise input control that complements clear communication, while the Stealth Ultra Controller provides advanced customization options for team-based games. When setting up your ultimate couch gaming setup with wireless controllers , remember that consistent hardware creates familiarity that translates to better coordination. Practice Makes Perfect Effective communication takes practice. Set aside time with your regular squad to work on specific skills. Practice callouts on new maps. Run drills where one player calls out enemy positions while others execute without visual confirmation. Research published in 2025 found that communication patterns serve as powerful predictors of team performance . Teams that play together develop shorthand, timing, and trust that translate to better performance. FAQs What makes a good gaming microphone for team communication? A good gaming microphone features a cardioid pickup pattern that focuses on your voice while minimizing background noise. Boom microphones positioned close to your mouth deliver clearer audio than built-in mics. How can I improve my callouts in competitive games? Learn standard callout names for each map and use them consistently. Be specific about enemy count, location, and threat level. Keep callouts concise during action and save detailed analysis for between rounds. Should I use push-to-talk or an open mic for gaming? Push-to-talk gives complete control over transmission and prevents accidental background noise. Open mic works well with excellent noise cancellation and quiet environments. Most competitive players prefer push-to-talk. How important is audio quality for competitive gaming? Audio quality directly impacts your ability to hear enemy footsteps, ability sounds, and directional cues. Clear microphone quality ensures teammates understand callouts the first time. Learn more about choosing between wired and wireless gaming headsets for your needs.

title: The Truth about Budget Gaming Brands: Turtle Beach Delivers without Compromise
summary: Why Turtle Beach gaming headsets offer unmatched value for budget gamers. Premium audio quality, comfort, and features at affordable prices.
body_text: When it comes to budget gaming brands, many gamers assume they'll have to sacrifice quality for affordability. However, this misconception couldn't be further from the truth, especially when discussing Turtle Beach gaming headsets. For nearly five decades, Turtle Beach has revolutionized the gaming audio landscape, proving that affordable gaming accessories can deliver premium performance without breaking the bank. Quality vs Price: What Budget Means for Gamers The gaming industry often presents a false dichotomy between affordability and quality, particularly when it comes to gaming headphones under budget. Many gamers believe that choosing budget options means accepting compromised sound quality, poor build construction, or limited features. However, Turtle Beach challenges this notion by delivering exceptional value-for-money gaming gear that competes with premium alternatives. Budget gaming brands review data consistently shows that Turtle Beach products outperform expectations in their price categories. The Turtle Beach Stealth 500, priced at around $80, delivers solid wireless performance with a comfortable, lightweight build and good mid-range audio quality. Shop the bestseller lineup now and grab the hottest deals while they last! Turtle Beach's Approach to Affordable Excellence Turtle Beach's philosophy centers on the belief that every gamer deserves access to professional-grade audio equipment, regardless of budget constraints. The company leverages decades of audio engineering expertise to optimize every component. Even budget Turtle Beach gaming headsets feature surprisingly accurate microphones and convincing sound quality, with the Recon 50 differentiating itself through comfort, sound quality, and microphone accuracy at only 209 grams. The Recon 70 headset exemplifies this philosophy perfectly. Despite its low price, the Recon 70 offers good sound with well-balanced bass, a decent microphone, and comfortable wear. Key Features of Turtle Beach Budget Gaming Headsets Superior Sound Engineering Turtle Beach sound quality remains consistent across their budget lineup thanks to proprietary audio technologies. The company's Signature Sound tuning ensures that even entry-level models deliver rich soundscapes that enhance gaming experiences. The Stealth 500's 40mm audio drivers deliver unpretentious sound that's not too overzealous, making it well-suited for RPGs and adventure games. Innovative Microphone Technology Communication clarity represents a cornerstone of Turtle Beach's design philosophy. Microphones are a strong point on even budget Turtle Beach gaming headsets, with the flip-to-mute mic providing crystal-clear voice communications. This flip-to-mute functionality has become a signature feature across their product range, ensuring seamless communication during intense gaming sessions. Comfort-Driven Design Turtle Beach performance and durability extend beyond audio quality to encompass long-term comfort. The Stealth 500 weighs just 8.28 ounces (235 grams) with exceptionally light clamp pressure, featuring deep, luxuriating memory foam cushioning that forms an effective passive noise barrier. Multi-Platform Compatibility Budget-conscious gamers often own multiple gaming platforms, and Turtle Beach addresses this reality with extensive compatibility options. The Stealth 600 Gen 2 Max offers seamless connectivity across Xbox, PlayStation, PC, and Nintendo Switch, eliminating the need for multiple headsets. Advanced Wireless Technology Wireless connectivity no longer represents a premium feature exclusive to expensive headsets. The Stealth 600 Gen 2 Max features over 48 hours of battery life, wireless low-latency 2.4GHz connection, and hassle-free wireless connectivity to nearly every console. How Turtle Beach Compares with Other Budget Brands When evaluating the best budget gaming headset options, Turtle Beach consistently emerges as a frontrunner against established competitors. Unlike generic budget brands that compromise on essential features, Turtle Beach maintains professional standards across its entire product range. Priced at $79.99, the Stealth 500 primarily competes against Sony's Pulse 3D and Microsoft's own Wireless Headset, benefiting over Sony's offering by including Bluetooth connectivity. This comparative advantage demonstrates how Turtle Beach adds value even within competitive price points. The company's extensive research and development investments result in features that competitors struggle to match. For example, the proprietary Superhuman Hearing technology amplifies critical in-game audio cues, providing competitive advantages typically associated with high-end gaming equipment. Innovation and Technology in Turtle Beach Products Turtle Beach's technological innovations extend far beyond basic audio reproduction. The company's SWARM II software platform provides extensive customization options with 10-band EQ adjustment, custom EQ creation, and detailed microphone control, including noise gate and mic monitoring. The Stealth 500 connects via 2.4GHz wireless dongle or Bluetooth, with quick-switch functionality and multiple platform compatibility. Ergonomic innovations like the floating headband design provide barely noticeable comfort with three adjustment settings. Why Compromise Is Not an Option with Turtle Beach The gaming community's evolution demands accessories that enhance rather than hinder performance. Turtle Beach refuses to compromise on essential features regardless of price point. Retailing for $99.99, the Stealth 600 Gen 3 provides great quality at a respectable price. The Stealth Pro headset represents the pinnacle of gaming audio technology, while budget-friendly options like the Recon 70 ensure that entry-level gamers access similar core technologies. With nearly 50 years of expertise as a pioneer in audio technology, Turtle Beach has established itself as one of the most recognized brand names in gaming. From the wireless capabilities of the Stealth 500 to the advanced features of the Atlas Air , Turtle Beach demonstrates that affordable excellence remains achievable. Conclusion Turtle Beach's approach to budget gaming proves that compromise isn't necessary when choosing affordable gaming accessories. title: Landing Pages Design: How Devs & Designers Can Build Pages
summary: A complete guide for developers and designers to create responsive, high-performing landing pages with expert tips, real examples, and technical best practices.
body_text: Landing pages look simple, but building ones that convert isn’t. Behind every clean layout is a mix of design psychology, code efficiency, and behavioral insight. If you’re building a platform, your users expect drag-and-drop freedom, responsive previews, and the ability to publish fast, without touching code. If you’re the one designing those pages, you care about what makes people stop scrolling, click, and act. This guide speaks to both. It breaks down key design elements like hero sections, structure, responsiveness, and media use, and shows how to build or enable them. You’ll see what works, why it works, and how top brands like Vimeo and Chanel apply these ideas. Whether you’re a developer embedding a builder or a designer using one, understanding both sides is what turns a simple page into a high-performing one. Why Are Landing Pages So Important? It’s easy to underestimate how much impact a single landing page can have. The right design can turn passive visitors into active customers, making it one of the most valuable tools in your marketing stack. For marketers, landing pages help you: Generate high-quality leads by channeling traffic to goal-specific pages instead of your homepage. Give every campaign a dedicated home where the value exchange (data for content) happens. Collect demographic and behavioral data from every form submission to refine targeting. Identify which leads are most engaged based on reconversions and repeat visits. Power multiple channels, such as email, PPC, and social, with optimized, shareable campaign pages. Measure and compare campaign performance using clear, page-level analytics. How Developers Hold the Key to High-Performing Landing Pages Landing pages aren’t only about visuals; they’re also about performance, scalability, and flexibility. Building one that loads fast, tracks user behavior correctly, and connects seamlessly to backend systems is a technical challenge, not a design one. That’s why developers play a decisive role in how well landing pages perform in real-world campaigns. Here’s how landing pages become a developer’s domain: Performance optimization: When pages load in one second, the average conversion rate is almost 40% . But with a two-second load time, the conversion drops to 34%. That gap is entirely in the developer’s hands, achieved through optimized code, lazy loading, and lightweight asset delivery. Scalability: Managing 10+ campaigns with consistent layouts, global components, and reusable modules is only possible with an innovative front-end architecture. Accurate event tracking: APIs must capture the right user actions, form submissions, and analytics events without breaking under traffic spikes. System integrations: Devs ensure that every signup or click syncs perfectly with CRMs, ESPs, and attribution tools. Cross-device responsiveness: You own the responsibility to ensure every block, form, and CTA behaves perfectly across screen sizes. Version control and rollback: The ability to version, roll back, and reuse landing page templates saves hours of rebuild time during updates or A/B tests. In short, landing pages are where marketing ambition meets engineering precision, and developers are the ones making sure that connection works at scale. Now, let's explore the core design elements that make landing pages effective and how to implement them properly. How Designers Can Create Landing Pages That Convert? A successful landing page is not defined by visuals alone. Visitors should be able to instantly understand the value offered and feel assured that taking the next step is worthwhile. Design choices influence how easily users can find key information, evaluate credibility, and progress without friction. For teams focused on crafting the user experience, the goal is to support clarity, relevance, and motivation at every stage of the page. Try including the following elements to elevate both user experience and conversion rates: 1. Responsive designs You'd be surprised to know that over 62% of internet users browse the web through mobile devices. This means that if the lion's share of people access the web through smartphones, you must ensure that your landing page designs are responsive and display well on all devices. 2. Captivating hero section Your landing page's hero section is the first thing that grabs a viewer's attention. So, it deserves your special attention and design focus. To create an outstanding and well-performing hero section, make sure these questions are clearly answered through your design and copy: What do you offer the visitors? Why should they trust your brand? How will your brand benefit the users? What action do they need to take to get the most out of that benefit? You can add attention-grabbing CTAs, headings, testimonials, and design elements to create a hero section that justifies its name because this is where your viewer will make the decision to stick around or leave! 3. Meaningful color palette According to research, 85% of people say that color is a primary reason for purchasing a product. So, you must choose colors that align with your brand's identity and product or service to win over your subscribers. Also, color psychology has a big influence on moods. Therefore, try to choose colors that positively impact your viewer's mood, such as yellow, green, light blue, and orange. Another important role that colors play is highlighting the elements of your page. For example, if you use a contrasting color for your CTA, people are more likely to notice and click on it. 4. Minimalist design Minimalist designs include sufficient negative space, fewer design elements, and are easier for visitors to digest. Besides looking visually pleasing, they are great at creating visual hierarchies and communicating messages more effectively. Minimalist designs are great at communicating messages more effectively because they have: Visual hierarchies Strong visual appeal A layout pattern (like Z or F) that naturally leads the eye to the primary CTA Stick to a simple, structured design. Avoid color-heavy or cluttered layouts that can overwhelm users. Even if you use interactive or animated elements, keep them subtle to maintain visual flow. 5. Explanatory videos 38.6% of marketers say video is the number one landing page element influencing conversions. Adding a concise video demo or walkthrough can directly improve engagement and conversion rates. In addition to boosting engagement, videos help your viewers understand your product/service quickly and thoroughly. However, when including videos, remember to create an enticing thumbnail, turn off autoplay, add subtitles, and include a CTA. 6. Enticing copy Your hero grabs attention, but the rest of your copy keeps it. Every headline, section header, and CTA should reinforce your offer and move the user closer to conversion. Use a consistent tone, avoid jargon, and tie every message back to a clear action. 7. Prominent testimonials Testimonials provide proof that real people have already benefited from your product or service. They reduce uncertainty, especially for first-time visitors who are still evaluating whether your offer will deliver the result they want. Highlight authentic customer feedback with clear names, photos, or company logos to make it more believable and visually consistent with your page design. 8. Consistent branding theme Color is one of the first things users notice, and it influences how they feel about your brand instantly. Over time, people begin to connect certain colors and styles with your product, making your brand more recognizable even before they see the logo. Think of how some brands can be identified by just a shade of blue or a signature gradient. Choose colors that truly reflect your brand’s personality and promise. Luxury products usually call for refined, understated tones, while energetic or youthful brands might go for bolder contrasts. Developer Playbook: Building High-Converting Landing Page Features Users today expect fast, polished experiences that adapt to their needs without heavy engineering effort. This means developers must create landing page components that are not only visually strong but also editable, scalable, and reusable within a visual builder. Here's how to support the landing page design in your platform effectively: Responsive editing: Add breakpoint-specific controls and live previews so users can adjust layouts for mobile, tablet, and desktop. Benchmark performance with tools like Lighthouse or WebPageTest to ensure smooth, fast loading. Customizable hero sections: Offer configurable hero blocks with editable text, CTAs, and background media. Let users switch visuals or layouts per device without code changes. Brand & theme management: Include color pickers, typography controls, and contrast validation for accessibility. Allow users to save brand palettes and apply them across templates for consistency. Flexible layout systems: Use grid-based templates with adjustable spacing and alignment. Keep interactive modules modular so users can toggle animations or effects as needed. Media optimization: Support responsive video and image embeds with lazy loading, custom thumbnails, and subtitle options to preserve speed and accessibility. Rich text & A/B testing: Provide inline editing with formatting controls, headline character limits, and built-in A/B testing hooks to measure copy effectiveness. Testimonials & social proof: Add testimonial blocks with star ratings, images, and schema markup for SEO-rich snippets. Offer layout choices like grids or carousels. Global templates & branding controls: Enforce brand consistency through template locking, global style settings, and enterprise-ready permissions. Smart layout patterns: Provide prebuilt Z-pattern and F-pattern layouts, drag-and-drop reordering, and responsive grids that keep designs aligned across screen sizes. Insightful Tips From Experts About Landing Page Designs We collected some valuable tips from SMEs about designing landing pages for conversion and compiled them here. Their advice centers on keeping copy value-driven, using short videos to encourage action, and balancing white space for clarity. These expert tips focus on design and conversion best practices, perfect for marketers and designers optimizing user-facing pages. If you're a developer, these insights can inform which features to prioritize in your platform to empower your users with similar creative flexibility. 5 Landing Page Examples: Design Inspiration + Development Insights You might be looking for some inspiration by now, and we've got exactly what you need. These examples showcase excellent design principles that drive landing page conversions. For each, we'll explore what makes the design effective and how developers can enable similar flexibility in their platforms. 1. Vimeo Industry: SaaS What makes this design effective: Interactive elements, such as videos that speak for their product's quality. An elegant yet captivating color palette. Minimalist layout design. How to enable this in your platform: Provide video embedding blocks with customizable thumbnails and autoplay controls. Offer pre-built color theme templates that users can apply with one click. Include minimalist layout options with flexible grid systems that prevent overcrowding. 2. Native Poppy Industry: Floral What makes this design effective: Colors that easily steal any visitor's attention. Prominent CTAs that clearly describe the action to be taken. Accurately displayed the brand theme through design. How to enable this in your platform: Implement color pickers with brand palette saving for consistent color application. Provide CTA button components with customizable text, colors, and size options. Enable brand template systems that enforce visual consistency across sections. 3. Dataddo Industry: SaaS What makes this design effective: Colors that go perfectly with their SaaS solution. An enticing yet comprehensive copy. Social proof with the best clients mentioned in the hero section. How to enable this in your platform: Support industry-specific color palette presets that align with different business types. Provide rich text editing with headline optimization tools and character counters. Build logo grid components and testimonial blocks that can be placed in hero sections. 4. Estee Lauder Industry: Beauty & Personal Care What makes this design effective: Displays products that speak volumes about their worth. Minimalist use of design elements. A simple and comprehensive copy. How to enable this in your platform: Provide image blocks with product showcase layouts and hover effect options. Create minimalist templates with generous white space and limited element options. Include copy blocks with formatting controls that encourage concise messaging. 5. Chanel Industry: Fashion What makes this design effective: Displays new products for promotion. Minimalist use of design elements. A simple and comprehensive copy. How to enable this in your platform: Build promotional content blocks with product feature capabilities and seasonal templates. Enforce spacing controls that maintain visual breathing room automatically. Support typography systems that prioritize readability and elegant simplicity. These examples show how strong design and smart implementation work together. When you build the editor right, end-users can recreate world-class landing pages directly inside the editor. Accelerate Landing Page Deployment With a Developer-Ready Builder Developers know that landing pages can be deceptively complex. Building one that’s fast, responsive, and customizable demands more than UI. It requires backend logic, template control, and ongoing updates that drain engineering time. What starts as a quick build often turns into months of patching layout bugs and managing dependencies. Unlayer’s embeddable Page Builder solves that problem. You get full SDK and API control to integrate a scalable, secure editor into your product within minutes. Let users design pages that load in seconds while your team focuses on innovation, not infrastructure. Embeddable SDK for rapid setup: Add a fully functional page builder to your app in minutes with just a few lines of code. Framework-agnostic architecture: Integrates seamlessly with React , Angular , Vue, or any JS stack without dependency conflicts. Comprehensive REST API and webhooks: Automate template management, export workflows, and event tracking through predictable endpoints. TypeScript support with clean definitions: Ensure type safety and maintainability across your development pipeline. Custom content blocks and UI controls: Extend the builder with your own logic, data inputs, and reusable design components. White-label customization options : Let users match your platform’s interface with custom themes, icons, workspace styling, and replace default logos and colors with their own branding. Version control and rollback options: Easily track design iterations and restore previous versions without code rewrites. Flexible hosting and storage options: Choose between Unlayer-hosted or self-hosted deployments for complete data control. Enterprise-grade uptime and security : SOC 2 compliant, 99.9% uptime SLA, and secure APIs for production environments. Detailed documentation and starter templates: Well-documented SDK, code samples, and boilerplate projects for fast onboarding. Cut deployment time from months to minutes. Book a demo and start building with Unlayer today. FAQs About Landing Page Design 1. What are the key components of a high-converting landing page? A high-converting landing page typically includes: Compelling headline: Grabs attention and clearly conveys the value proposition. Engaging visuals: High-quality images or videos that resonate with the target audience. Clear Call-to-Action (CTA): Prominent and persuasive prompts guiding users towards the desired action. Social proof: Testimonials, reviews, or trust badges that build credibility. Responsive design: Ensures optimal viewing across devices. Fast loading speed: Reduces bounce rates and improves user experience. 2. How can I optimize my landing page for mobile users? To enhance mobile usability: Responsive layouts: Utilize flexible grids and scalable images. Touch-friendly elements: Ensure buttons and links are easily tappable. Minimalist design: Reduce clutter to improve navigation. Fast load times: Optimize images and scripts for quicker loading. Accessible forms: Simplify forms for easier completion on mobile devices. 3. What role does A/B testing play in landing page optimization? A/B testing allows you to compare two versions of a landing page to determine which performs better. By testing different headlines, CTAs, or layouts, you can make data-driven decisions to enhance conversion rates. 4. How can I integrate Unlayer into my application effectively? You can connect Unlayer's API to integrate the editor, allowing users to create and edit landing pages reliably within your platform. For a full walkthrough, check how to embed Unlayer in enterprise applications . 5. How can I ensure accessibility in my landing page design? To make landing pages accessible: Use semantic HTML: Properly structure content for screen readers. Provide text alternatives: Offer alt text for images and videos. Ensure keyboard navigation: Allow users to navigate using a keyboard. Test with accessibility tools : Utilize tools like WAVE or Axe to identify issues.

title: MGP Ingredients Announces Board Transition
summary: ATCHISON, Kan.--(BUSINESS WIRE)-- MGP Ingredients, Inc. (Nasdaq:MGPI), a leading provider of branded and distilled spirits and food ingredient…...
body_text: MGP Ingredients Announces Board Transition December 16, 2025 4:30pm EST Download as PDF ATCHISON, Kan.--(BUSINESS WIRE)-- MGP Ingredients, Inc. (Nasdaq:MGPI), a leading provider of branded and distilled spirits and food ingredient solutions, announced that following over 15 years of distinguished service, Karen Seaberg retired from the company’s Board of Directors, effective December 14, 2025. Julie Francis, president and chief executive officer, has been appointed to serve as a director on the company’s Board, effective December 15, 2025. “Karen’s contributions to MGP span decades and reflect her deep commitment to the company. As a long-standing director, including serving as Chairman of the Board from 2014 to 2024, she has provided steady leadership through periods of significant growth and transformation. On behalf of the Board, I want to express our sincere gratitude for her service, her stewardship, and her thoughtful counsel,” said Martin Roper, Chairman of the Board. He continued, “We are also pleased to welcome Julie to the Board. Since joining as CEO, Julie has demonstrated strong leadership and strategic focus, and her perspective from leading the organization will further strengthen the Board as we continue to execute our long-term strategy.” Seaberg commented, “Serving on the MGP Board has been a meaningful part of my life, and I am deeply proud of the company’s evolution and the people who make it special. MGP’s roots in Atchison and my family’s history with the company have always been close to my heart, and I feel this is the right time for a thoughtful transition given the significant progress the Company has made in attracting and retaining the leadership and talent to execute the next phase of its vision. I look forward to continuing my support of MGP and the Atchison community in new ways.” Francis remarked, “I am honored to join the MGP Board. Having worked closely with the Board since becoming CEO, I welcome the opportunity to contribute as a director. Together, we will continue to build on MGP’s strong heritage, advance our long-term strategy, and create long-term value for all of our stakeholders.” About MGP Ingredients, Inc. MGP Ingredients, Inc. (Nasdaq: MGPI) has been formulating excellence since 1941 by bringing product ideas to life across the alcoholic beverage and specialty ingredient industries through three segments: Branded Spirits, Distilling Solutions, and Ingredient Solutions. MGP is one of the leading spirits distillers with an award-winning portfolio of premium brands including Penelope, Rebel, Remus, and Yellowstone bourbons and El Mayor tequila, under the Luxco umbrella. With distilleries in Indiana and Kentucky, a tequila distillery joint venture in Arandas, Mexico, and bottling operations in Missouri, Ohio, and Northern Ireland, the company creates distilled spirits for customers including many world-renowned spirits brands. In addition, the company’s high-quality specialty fiber, protein, and starch ingredients provide functional, nutritional, and sensory solutions for a wide range of food products. To learn more, please visit MGPIngredients.com . title: SWORN 1.0 Update #1 is LIVE!
summary: Arthur has brought in some reinforcements! Three new alternate Bosses have been introduced + more!
body_text: Arthur has brought in some reinforcements! Three new alternate Bosses have been introduced. When playing on Knight difficulty or higher, these new foes can sometimes appear at the end of a Biome instead of the Boss you normally would encounter. New Content Lady Kay, Wall of Camelot Though corrupted, Lady Kay remains a stalwart warrior in service to Arthur. She guards the entrance to Cornwall with her gigantic shield, pummeling down any who dare challenge Arthur’s rule. Her greatshield is not unbreakable, however, and if the Soulforged can find a way to power through her defenses, they have a shot at taking her down. Sir Dagonet, Grasp of The Mire This gluttonous former Knight revels in his newfound power, delighted at any new playthings entering his swamp. His devastating hook can render Soulforged immobile, as he drags them around his swamp filled with traps and poison. Clever warriors will need to dismantle his fixtures around the arena, before they drown in Sir Dagonet’s mire. Lady Agravain, Scourge of Ships The source of much of the shipwrecks and current state of Deep Harbor, Lady Agravain has been rendered completely mad from her transformation. In a flurry of feathers and steel, this terrifying adversary dashes around her nest with breakneck speed, ripping unprepared Soulforged to shreds. Only those able to read her movements have a chance at keeping up. Changelog Weapons & Blessings Increased the Bonus Attack Speed internal maximum from 50% to 100% (total attack speed cap is now 2x, instead of 1.5x) Added a Perfect Shot indicator for the Tome's Augment 'Book Mark’ Updated VFX for the Greathammer Fixed a case where Oberon's Flow status would give far more attack speed than intended Fixed a case where the Gauntlets Augment 'Flying Fists' would give far more attack speed than intended Fixed an instance where, on some lower end machines, Lugh's Ultimate attack 'Stroke of Luck' did an extra 1500 damage at close range Fixed an interaction where the Staff Sword in the Stone upgrade 'Magic Guard' would not interact favorably with other forms of damage reduction or damage prevention Fixed a bug that would sometimes cause the Arcane Blades to have the incorrect skin appear for certain players Fixed Hammer Sword in the Stone upgrade 'Bludgeon' description to include the knockback value (yes it is actually +400%, the base knockback is very low) Fixed a bug that caused excessive screen shake when using the Dragon Dive spell Enemies & Levels Added 3 new alternate Bosses that can appear on Knight difficulty or higher Updated the Deep Harbor Wave Thrower to now be a Major Foe, health increased from 1050 to 2500 Wave Thrower will now summon Minor Foes periodically, similar to other Major Foes Wave Thrower has altered behavior where it will periodically shoot three waves in rapid succession before repositioning Changed several mob reposition abilities to not have their speed increased by positive attack speed modifiers (they will still be slowed down by Beira's Chill effect) Major Suncaster (the big pink donut guy in Biome 5) Health changed from 1500 to 2500 - he actually had lower health and stun thresholds than his Minor counterpart Major Suncaster Stun threshold changed from 200 to 1000 Major Suncaster Freeze threshold changed from 20 to 25 Made the Fire Breath attack on Arthur, Avarice Incarnate easier to dodge through perpendicular to the direction of the breath Updated the VFX for various event rooms and post-room events Fixed an issue that caused corruptions to appear on the Castle Bridge level briefly Fixed a case where the Room Corruption that increased enemy attack speed was granting far more attack speed than intended Fixed an issue where the Deep Harbor Ocean Serpent could wobble out of control when getting hit during certain animations Fixed an issue where sometimes, the Freeze effect VFX would not display properly on water-bound enemies General Changed the application's cursor capture behavior to release the cursor while using menus - this should allow you to move your cursor outside the window on PC while the escape menu is open, but shouldn’t allow you to move your cursor outside the playspace during gameplay by accident Fixed an issue that could sometimes cause players to be locked out of certain actions after cutscenes Fixed a bug that caused the party UI to disappear after certain cutscenes Fixed various issues with emotes and the emote mirror menu Fixed an issue that could cause various tooltips to appear offscreen after changing the game’s resolution on PC Fixed certain cases where, on PC, the mouse scroll wheel would not move through menus as intended Fixed certain network crashes related to crossplay between Epic and Steam Other various fixes Join in now! body_text: AXIL Unveils MX II Next Generation Earmuffs Featuring Advanced SonicShieldX™ Technology Flagship MX II PRO will be available for preorder in January 2026, with deliveries expected in February 2026 Los Angeles, CA – December 18, 2025 – AXIL Brands, Inc. (NYSE American: AXIL), a leading innovator in hearing protection, enhancement, and audio technology, is excited to announce the upcoming launch of the MX II Series earmuffs. The MX II introduces the company's cutting-edge next-generation SonicShieldX™ technology platform, delivering superior hearing protection, sound enhancement, and unmatched comfort for outdoor enthusiasts and professionals in high-noise environments. The flagship MX II PRO model, the first in the series, will be available for preorder starting January 5, 2026, with deliveries expected in February 2026. This premium all-in-one electronic earmuff combines advanced Bluetooth connectivity, powerful hearing amplification, and instant compression of harmful noises above 85 dB, all while offering enhanced customizable features and rugged durability. Additional variants, the MX II Electronic (focused on essential sound enhancement and protection without Bluetooth) and MX II Passive (reliable non-electronic noise reduction for everyday use), are scheduled for release in May 2026. "Following the enthusiastic response to our GS Extreme 3.0 incorporating the SonicShieldX technology, we're excited to bring the next evolution in over-the-ear protection with the MX II Series," said Jeff Toghraie, Chairman and Chief Executive Officer of AXIL Brands. "The new platform represents a major leap forward, providing even better situational awareness, wind noise reduction, sound quality, and seamless integration of protection and enhancement ensuring users can hear what they need while staying safe from damaging sounds." Key highlights of the MX II Series include: Next-Generation SonicShieldX Technology : Enhanced automatic sound compression, improved ambient sound amplification (up to 6X for safe levels), and superior clarity in challenging environments. Comfort and Durability : Lightweight, sweat- and water-resistant design with adjustable headbands and easy-to-clean cushions for all-day wear. Customizable Options : Interchangeable ear pads and plates for personalization with eco-friendly packaging. Versatile Performance : Ideal for construction sites, concerts, sporting events, loud workplaces, and more. The MXII Series continues AXIL’s commitment to innovation in dual-function hearing technology, allowing users to protect their hearing without sacrificing awareness or communication. title: C3 AI Announces Fiscal Second Quarter 2026 Results
summary: C3 AI Q2 FY2026 results show revenue up 7% from the prior quarter, with the company's federal bookings up 89% from a year earlier. Read the announcement.
body_text: Revenue increases 7% QoQ as Federal bookings grow 89% YoY REDWOOD CITY, Calif. — December 3, 2025 — C3.ai, Inc. (“ C3 AI, ” “C3,” or the “Company”) (NYSE: AI), the Enterprise AI application software company, today announced financial results for its fiscal second quarter ended October 31, 2025. “We delivered a solid quarter driven by excellent performance in our Federal business and increased high-value deal activity across our customer base. The Federal market continues to be a large growth vector for us,” said Stephen Ehikian, CEO, C3 AI. “Both Federal and commercial customers want to move faster, scale sooner, and embed AI as a core operating capability that delivers measurable economic value — and our platform is built for this moment.” Fiscal Second Quarter 2026 Financial Highlights: Total Revenue was $75.1 million. Subscription Revenue was $70.2 million. Subscription revenue constituted 93% of total revenue. Subscription and Prioritized Engineering Services Revenue Combined was $74.2 million, constituting 99% of total revenue. GAAP gross profit was $30.4 million, representing a 40% gross margin. Non-GAAP gross profit was $40.9 million, representing a 54% non-GAAP gross margin. GAAP net loss per share was $(0.75). Non-GAAP net loss per share was $(0.25). Cash, cash equivalents, and marketable securities was $675.0 million. Business Highlights C3 AI’s results were driven by accelerating partner activity and significant growth and expansion across the Federal business. In Q2, the Company closed 46 agreements including new and expanded agreements with AMD, GSK, Air Products, U.S. Steel, Signature Aviation, BAE Systems, La Poste, Holcim, Cargill, and Duke Energy, among others. Total bookings increased by 49% quarter-over-quarter, driven by expansions and increased high-value deal activity, including 17 agreements greater than $1 million and six agreements greater than $5 million. C3 AI’s Federal business experienced significant traction across multiple government agencies as bookings across federal, defense and aerospace grew 89% year-over-year. 89% of total bookings were driven with and through the C3 AI partner ecosystem. Verdantix named C3 AI a Leader in industrial AI, awarding the Company the highest overall scores in its 2025 Green Quadrant: Industrial AI Analytics Software report. Federal Business Federal growth accelerated, despite headwinds from the government shutdown, as agencies and partners navigate the shift from custom government off-the-shelf (GOTS) builds to mandated commercial-off-the-shelf technology (COTS) solutions. In Q2, total bookings across federal, defense and aerospace increased by 89% year-over-year, and represented 45% of total bookings. The Company entered into new and expansion agreements with the U.S. Department of Health and Human Services, BAE Systems, the U.S. Department of War, the U.S. Intelligence Community, the U.S. Army, the Naval Air Warfare Center Aircraft Division, Naval Sea Systems Command, the U.S. Marine Corps, and the Los Alamos National Laboratory, among others. The U.S. Department of Health and Human Services, including the National Institutes of Health and the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services, selected C3 AI to establish a unified, secure, and scalable data foundation for Enterprise AI. The Department will use C3 Agentic AI to automate complex, labor-intensive administrative workflows. Booz Allen Hamilton, one of the largest Federal systems integrators, joined the C3 AI Strategic Integrator Program (SIP) licensing the C3 Agentic AI Platform to develop and commercialize COTS solutions in compliance with the new federal government COTS imperative. Partner Network C3 AI’s partner ecosystem, including Microsoft, AWS, McKinsey & Company, Baker Hughes, Booz Allen, and others, continues to be a tremendous source of operating leverage. In Q2, the Company closed 38 agreements with and through its partner network, representing 89% of total bookings. The joint 12-month qualified opportunity pipeline with partners increased by 108% year-over-year. C3 AI and Microsoft celebrated the first anniversary of their strategic alliance during which the companies have jointly closed more than 100 customer agreements across 17 industries, generating over $130 million in C3 AI bookings. In Q2, C3 AI and Microsoft jointly closed 24 agreements and expanded deal activity contributed to a 146% year-over-year increase in qualified pipeline. C3 AI and AWS jointly closed nine agreements and hosted multiple C-suite executive events to drive 172% year-over-year increase in joint qualified pipeline. C3 Generative AI In Q2, the Company entered into eight new and expanded agreements for C3 Generative AI with the U.S. Intelligence Community, Cargill, Bristol Myers Squibb, and TRAC Intermodal, among others. In State & Local Government, the Company closed production agreements of C3 Generative AI with government agencies in New Jersey and Tennessee. C3 AI launched C3 AI Agentic Process Automation, a new solution that will change how enterprises operate and expand use of the C3 Agentic AI Platform. This solution enables organizations to encapsulate full business workflows and industrial processes as autonomous AI agents: users describe complex workflows in natural language and the system automatically builds and deploys them in minutes. Additional CEO Commentary “We have crafted a detailed execution plan and put in place precise operational objectives for each business unit,” said Stephen Ehikian, CEO, C3 AI. “This plan prioritizes our execution in areas where we have demonstrable leadership, clear customer success, and the right to win, and concentrates our efforts on our fastest-growing sectors. I believe the execution of this plan will facilitate our return to growth and provide a clear pathway to cash generation and non-GAAP profitability.” Financial Outlook: The Company’s guidance includes GAAP and non-GAAP financial measures. The following table summarizes C3 AI’s guidance for the third quarter of fiscal 2026 and full-year fiscal 2026: (in millions) Total revenue $72.0 – $80.0 $289.5 – $309.5 Non-GAAP loss from operations $(44.0) – $(52.0) $(180.5) – $(210.5) A reconciliation of non-GAAP guidance measures to corresponding GAAP measures is not available on a forward-looking basis without unreasonable effort due to the uncertainty regarding, and the potential variability of, expenses that may be incurred in the future. Stock-based compensation expense-related charges, including employer payroll tax-related items on employee stock transactions, are impacted by the timing of employee stock transactions, the future fair market value of our common stock, and our future hiring and retention needs, all of which are difficult to predict and subject to constant change. We have provided a reconciliation of GAAP to non-GAAP financial measures in the financial statement tables for our historical non-GAAP results included in this press release. Our fiscal year ends April 30, and numbers are rounded for presentation purposes. Conference Call Details What: C3 AI Second Quarter Fiscal Year 2026 Financial Results Conference Call When: Wednesday, December 3, 2025 Time: 2:00 p.m. PT / 5:00 p.m. ET Participant Registration: (live) Webcast: (live and replay) Investor Presentation Details An investor presentation providing additional information and analysis can be found at our investor relations page at ir.c3.ai. Statement Regarding Use of Non-GAAP Financial Measures The Company reports the following non-GAAP financial measures, which have not been prepared in accordance with generally accepted accounting principles in the United States (“GAAP”), in addition to, and not as a substitute for, or superior to, financial measures calculated in accordance with GAAP. Non-GAAP gross profit, non-GAAP gross margin, non-GAAP loss from operations, and non-GAAP net loss per share. Our non-GAAP gross profit, non-GAAP gross margin, non-GAAP loss from operations, and non-GAAP net loss per share exclude the effect of stock-based compensation expense-related charges and employer payroll tax expense related to employee stock-based compensation. We believe the presentation of operating results that exclude these non-cash items provides useful supplemental information to investors and facilitates the analysis of our operating results and comparison of operating results across reporting periods. Free cash flow. We believe free cash flow, a non-GAAP financial measure, is useful in evaluating liquidity and provides information to management and investors about our ability to fund future operating needs and strategic initiatives. We calculate free cash flow as net cash used in operating activities less purchases of property and equipment and capitalized software development costs. This non-GAAP financial measure may be different than similarly titled measures used by other companies. Additionally, the utility of free cash flow is further limited as it does not represent the total increase or decrease in our cash balances for a given period. We use these non-GAAP financial measures internally for financial and operational decision-making purposes and as a means to evaluate period-to-period comparisons. Non-GAAP financial measures are not meant to be considered in isolation or as a substitute for comparable GAAP financial measures and should be read only in conjunction with our condensed consolidated financial statements prepared in accordance with GAAP. Our presentation of non-GAAP financial measures may not be comparable to similar measures used by other companies. We encourage investors to carefully consider our results under GAAP, as well as our supplemental non-GAAP information and the reconciliation between these presentations, to more fully understand our business. Please see the tables included at the end of this release for the reconciliation of GAAP to non-GAAP financial measures. Other Information Professional Services Revenue Our professional services revenue includes service fees and prioritized engineering services. Service fees include revenue from services such as consulting, training, and paid implementation services. Prioritized engineering services are undertaken when a customer requests that we accelerate the design, development, and delivery of software features and functions that are planned in our future product roadmap. When we agree to this, we negotiate an agreed upon fee to accelerate the development of the software. When the software feature is delivered, it becomes integrated to our core product offering, is available to all subscribers of the underlying software product, and enhances the operation of that product going forward. Such prioritized engineering services result in production-level computer software – compiled code that enhances the functionality of our production products – which is available for our customers to use over the life of their software licenses. Per Accounting Standards Codification (ASC) 606, Prioritized engineering services revenue is recognized as professional services over the period in which the software development is completed.
